title.value: Multi-objective PSO semi-supervised random forest method for dioxin soft sensor
title.justification: The title is explicitly mentioned at the beginning of the paper.
title.quote: Multi-objective PSO semi-supervised random forest method for dioxin soft sensor

analysis.description: The paper proposes a multi-objective particle swarm optimization (PSO) semi-supervised random forest (RF) algorithm for measuring dioxin emission concentration in municipal solid waste incineration (MSWI) processes. The method addresses challenges such as limited labeled samples and the optimization of hyperparameters in semi-supervised models, using a combination of benchmark and actual MSWI process datasets to verify its effectiveness.

type.justification: The paper involves the design of an algorithm and its empirical evaluation using benchmark and actual MSWI datasets.
type.quote: The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by using benchmark and actual MSWI process datasets.
